Main.dc.html.title: In context: Swamp panel in Orca's right sidebar

Ambient.dc.html.title: 6 · Outside the panel: status bar + notification

s1.text:
How it works

• One sidebar panel, two tabs: Workflows and Factories.
• A plugin worker (Node) runs `swamp … --json` in the focused workspace. The panel has no network access.
• Scope v1: view + approve/reject. No editing.
• Repo = the swamp repo of the current Orca workspace.
• Theme: the plugin ships an optional 'Swamp' Orca color theme. Switch Orca / Swamp in each artboard's Tweaks.

s2.text:
Open questions

1. Vertical pipeline vs DAG graph for the stage view?
2. Should the status bar show waiting gates across ALL workspaces?
3. Auto-refresh: poll every few seconds, or only while a run is active?
